However, our cost management and operational efficiency initiatives, together with targeted pricing actions and growth in our payments and data businesses, contributed to improvements in consolidated adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA margin compared to the first nine months of 2025.
We do not expect the remaining expense associated with Celero integration activities to be material.

The majority of the employee reductions included in our restructuring and integration accruals as of September 30, 2026, along with the related severance payments, are expected to be completed by early 2027.

Workforce reductions implemented in 2025 and 2026 are expected to generate cost savings of approximately $2.0 million in cost of revenue and $17.0 million in SG&A expense in 2026 compared to our 2025 results.
These projected savings reflect only the impact of workforce reductions and do not represent the total benefits of our cost reduction initiatives.

Adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA margin also improved in the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 compared to the same periods in 2025, reflecting contributions from the Celero acquisition and new customer implementations, targeted pricing actions, and cost management initiatives.

Total revenue increased in the third quarter of 2026 compared to the third quarter of 2025, driven by revenue from a software license agreement within our broader suite of treasury management offerings, higher remittance processing volumes, and targeted price increases to mitigate the impact of inflation.

Adjusted EBITDA and adjusted EBITDA margin also increased in the third quarter and first nine months of 2026 compared to the same periods in 2025, driven by targeted pricing actions and ongoing cost management initiatives, including operational efficiencies within our lockbox processing operations and more efficient marketing spending.

While the Celero acquisition increases our debt and leverage levels in the near term, we believe anticipated cash flows from operations, together with available capacity under our credit arrangements, will be sufficient to support our ongoing operations and service our debt obligations.
We will continue to evaluate opportunities to optimize our capital structure.
